rv.q: A lunatic farce that's as black as a policeman's hat, 'The Ladykillers' is as irresistible as ever.
With a little extra pace, this highly entertaining revival will match the original.
Sean Foley abjures such nuances and gives us a bunch of clowns in a two-hour slapstick routine. This approach deprives the tale of all its subtlety and shadowy strangeness.
Adapted by Graham LinehamDirected by Sean Foley★★★★Pros: The main cast are skilled in delivering slapstick comedy and have excellent comic timing.
